what_changed:
User profiles (issue #24).
• Create, rename and delete saved accounts, choose a launch profile, and switch from the top bar or connection settings
• Save the current connection form as a new profile, including local URL, custom headers and client certificates
• Isolate library/thumbnail caches, upload queues, folder sync settings and sync state for each account; switching pauses the previous account
• Migrate existing settings into a Personal profile while preserving its cached library

Thumbnails load faster when scrolling (PR #23).
• Cached thumbnails show right away instead of waiting behind downloads
• Tiles you scroll past quickly aren't downloaded; what's on screen loads first, then the tiles around it
• The viewer's preview no longer waits behind grid thumbnails

Favorites: add or remove favorites from the viewer and the right-click menu (PR #22).
• Heart button in the viewer, or press F; favorites show a heart on their thumbnail
• Needs the asset.update permission; failures show as a toast instead of a status line

Settings: the back button moved from the sidebar into the settings header and returns to Library or Explore, whichever you came from; Esc works too (PR #21).
• Back buttons in Library and Explore no longer show two arrows

Appearance: the custom palette can also set text, muted text and border colors, and the top bar logo follows the text color (PR #20).

Sidebar: library sections for People, Favorites, Archive, Albums, Tags, Folders and Trash (PR #19).
